title: Platform · GitHub runners
description: Scale set mk4 (runs-on: mk4) of the mrjithendar organization, from Actions Runner Controller's listener and controller (job arc): jobs, how long they wait for a runner pod and how long they run. Runner pods' CPU and memory: Platform · GitHub runner pods.

links.title: jithendar.com
links.tooltip: Articles about how this is built

panels.title: Listener
panels.description: The pod in runners-system that long-polls GitHub for jobs queued for mk4 and scales the runner pods. Down: no job with runs-on: mk4 starts.

panels.title: Controller
panels.description: Actions Runner Controller (runners-system): creates and deletes the runner pods and the listener. Down: running jobs finish, but no new runner pod is created.

panels.title: Jobs running
panels.description: Jobs a runner pod is executing now.

panels.title: Jobs waiting for a runner
panels.description: Jobs GitHub has assigned to mk4 that no runner has picked up yet: their pod is starting, pulling images, or Pending until a worker has room for its requests.

panels.title: Runners busy
panels.description: Registered runners running a job.

panels.title: Runners idle
panels.description: Registered runners waiting for a job (minRunners keeps some idle; unset: none).

panels.title: Max runners
panels.description: maxRunners in deploy/minikube/runners/values.yaml. Unset: ARC uses 2147483647, shown as No limit; then only the pods' CPU and memory requests bound how many run at once.

panels.title: Jobs finished
panels.description: Jobs that ran on mk4 and finished, any result. A job name's first run after the listener starts is not counted: Prometheus needs a sample before it to see the increase.

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Jobs that finished with result failed. A job name's first run after the listener starts is not counted: Prometheus needs a sample before it to see the increase.

panels.title: Cancelled
panels.description: Jobs cancelled while on a runner (a newer push, concurrency, or cancelled by hand). A job name's first run after the listener starts is not counted: Prometheus needs a sample before it to see the increase.

panels.title: Wait for a runner (p95)
panels.description: From GitHub assigning a job to mk4 to a runner starting it: scheduling the pod (it stays Pending while no worker has room), pulling images, starting Docker, registering.

panels.title: Run time (p50)
panels.description: From a runner starting the job to the job finishing.

panels.title: Runner time used
panels.description: Sum of every job's run time: what these jobs would have used of GitHub-hosted minutes.

panels.title: Jobs assigned, running and waiting
panels.description: assigned: jobs GitHub gave to mk4 (running or waiting); running: on a runner; waiting: assigned minus running.

panels.title: Runners
panels.description: desired: how many runners the listener asked for; registered: runners GitHub knows; busy and idle split the registered ones.

panels.title: Runner pods by phase
panels.description: The controller's EphemeralRunners. pending: pod not running a job yet (starting, or Pending for lack of room on a worker); failed: the pod failed to start or run.

panels.title: Jobs finished by result
panels.description: Jobs finished in each 10-minute bucket.

panels.title: Jobs finished by repository
panels.description: Jobs finished in each 10-minute bucket.

panels.title: Jobs
panels.description: Every job (repository and job name) that finished in the time range. Wait and run time are averages; p95 comes from the histogram buckets. Runner time is the sum of run times.

targets.expr: sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_startup_duration_seconds_sum{job="arc", repository=~"$repository"}[$__range])) / sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_startup_duration_seconds_count{job="arc", repository=~"$repository"}[$__range]))

sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_execution_duration_seconds_sum{job="arc", repository=~"$repository"}[$__range])) / sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_execution_duration_seconds_count{job="arc", repository=~"$repository"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (repository, job_name, le) (increase(gha_job_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{job="arc", repository=~"$repository"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Wait for a runner
panels.description: Jobs that started in the last 15 minutes or so, at each point. Long waits: pods Pending for lack of room on a worker (Platform · GitHub runner pods), or image pulls.

panels.title: Wait for a runner (p95) by repository
Run time
panels.description: Jobs that finished in the last 15 minutes or so, at each point.

panels.title: Runner time used per hour by repository
panels.description: Sum of the run times of the jobs that finished in each hour.

panels.title: Reconciles by controller
panels.description: How often each of ARC's controllers handled a change.

panels.title: Reconcile errors
panels.description: Errors are retried. A steady rate: the controller's log says why (kubectl -n runners-system logs deploy/arc-gha-rs-controller).

panels.title: Work queue depth
panels.description: Changes waiting for a controller. Stays near 0 unless the controller is stuck or the API server is slow.

panels.title: Memory (controller, listener)
panels.description: Working set of the ARC pods in runners-system, from cAdvisor.
